changeSet.author: aqua-rush

preConditions.onErrorMessage: delivery_workers 表已不存在,跳过合并迁移

changeSet.comment: Merge delivery_workers profile into admins single table
changeSet.sql: UPDATE admins a SET avatar_url = dw.avatar_url, online_status = dw.online_status, coordinates = dw.coordinates, current_location = dw.current_location, rating = dw.rating, total_orders = dw.total_orders, completed_orders = dw.completed_orders, average_rating = dw.average_rating, earning_cents = dw.earning_cents, is_available = dw.is_available FROM delivery_workers dw WHERE dw.admin_id = a.id
UPDATE orders o SET delivery_worker_id = a.id FROM delivery_workers dw JOIN admins a ON a.id = dw.admin_id WHERE dw.id = o.delivery_worker_id
UPDATE reviews r SET delivery_worker_id = a.id FROM delivery_workers dw JOIN admins a ON a.id = dw.admin_id WHERE dw.id = r.delivery_worker_id
UPDATE delivery_worker_statistics s SET delivery_worker_id = a.id FROM delivery_workers dw JOIN admins a ON a.id = dw.admin_id WHERE dw.id = s.delivery_worker_id
UPDATE daily_collection_records d SET delivery_worker_id = a.id FROM delivery_workers dw JOIN admins a ON a.id = dw.admin_id WHERE dw.id = d.delivery_worker_id
UPDATE admins a SET username = 'delivery_' || a.id WHERE a.username LIKE 'delivery\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admins a2 WHERE a2.username = 'delivery_' || a.id )
